title: Written incident report at Colonel Spraker's office, never given a copy
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: handed me these he handed me these forms he said I need you to write down every single thing that happened on that site tonight from the time you got this alarm to to the completion
The Flight Chief, MSgt ----- ------, and Assistant Flight Chief, TSgt. ---- ------, met us at the facility for a debrief.
I did fill out an AF Form 1000 UFO sighting report and wrote all I knew about that night and early morning, before I was allowed to sleep.

plain: After his 1977 encounter at a nuclear missile site, Mario Woods says he was made to write a full report of what happened, and, as the story goes, he never got a copy. Woods, a former Air Force missile security guard, tells Michels that Colonel Spraker handed him forms at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota and said, "I need you to write down every single thing that happened on that site tonight from the time you got this alarm to the completion." He places Jack Reed, a captain in the Air Force Office of Special Investigations (the Air Force's own investigative service), at the debriefing beside another of its agents, Rick Doty. Woods also wrote about the night for the researcher Robert Hastings, who published it on 10 September 2017. In that account the debriefing is with the Flight Chief and his assistant, who "met us at the facility", and Woods says, "I did fill out an AF Form 1000 UFO sighting report and wrote all I knew about that night and early morning, before I was allowed to sleep." His meeting with the wing commander comes "the next day" at Ellsworth. So the 2017 text puts the written report at the missile facility and the later telling puts it in the colonel's office, a difference of place, unless he wrote a second report that the 2017 account does not mention. If the report exists, it would be an official written record of the night.

discussion.by: Former USAF Missile Security Policeman Tells of Apparent UFO Abduction at ICBM Site
discussion.text: In the account Woods wrote for Hastings in 2017 the written report is "an AF Form 1000 UFO sighting report", filled out at the debriefing by the Flight Chief at November Control "before I was allowed to sleep"; his interview with the wing commander comes "the next day" at Ellsworth. The later telling has the forms handed to him in Colonel Spraker's office at the base, a difference of place, unless he wrote a second report the 2017 text does not mention.
